content:
incident-bot: [P1] routing: us-west-2 p95/p99 spike detected for /v1/streaming endpoints. SLO breach started 1759123400. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abcd/ingress-latency?orgId=1

sre-oncall-morgan: saw it. p95 ~ 420ms -> 1.2s, p99 ~ 2.8s. Streaming stalls reported by 3 customers.

router-eng-lee: looking at router logs now. I'm seeing a sudden fanout to a small subset of backends (hot partition). routing policy "regional-splay-v2" pushed ~10:15 UTC.

ingress-eng-anya: confirm — rollout at 10:14:43. metrics show 80% of streaming requests landing on shard-07 in us-west-2.

prod-ops: any customer-facing degradation?

cust-success-jorge: 2 paying customers opened tickets: one reports chunked responses stalling, second reports reconnects. both tagged "streaming" feature.

sre-oncall-morgan: mitigation plan: 1) flip routing to fallback pool, 2) drain shard-07, 3) page router-eng for root cause. I'm going to enable the fallback now.

scheduler-bot: scheduled action: enable fallback-policy us-west-2 -> fallback-pool at 1759123490 (initiated by morgan).

sre-oncall-morgan: enabled fallback. traffic rebalanced within ~35s. p95 dropped to ~380ms, p99 to ~900ms but still above SLO.

router-eng-lee: can you run: 
```
rgctl route adjust-weight --region usw2 --policy regional-splay-v2 --decrease 20
```
This will reduce affinity to hot shard while we investigate.

ingress-eng-anya: running adjust-weight now.

router-eng-lee: logs show sticky-evaporation TTL not applied correctly after rollout; keys are staying tied to shard-07 longer than expected. suspect policy bug in weight decay.

sre-oncall-morgan: alternative immediate: enable eager-fallback for streaming route to avoid hot shard binding. Thoughts?

router-eng-lee: do it. that'll buy us time. also start draining hot shard-07:
```
rgctl shard drain --shard shard-07 --region usw2 --timeout 300
```

prod-ops: warming up extra capacity in fallback-pool now (3 GPUs).

scheduler-bot: capacity change applied: +3 gpus to fallback-pool at 1759123560.

sre-oncall-morgan: monitoring customer errors and reconnects. adding annotation to incident: impact: streaming stalls, reconnects, partial degraded throughput for customers X,Y.

cust-success-jorge: I've messaged both customers with high-level note and ETA ~20–30m. They asked to be notified when fully restored.

router-eng-lee: drain completed for shard-07 at 1759123665. logs show residual KV cache hits still routing to drained hosts for ~45s due to client-side cache TTL. we should add a policy to purge prefix cache on reroute.

ingress-eng-anya: confirmed p99 down to 420ms, p95 back in SLO at 190ms. streaming error rate trending to normal.

sre-oncall-morgan: marking live mitigation successful for now. we'll keep incident open for root cause and a post-mortem. next steps:
- router team to revert or patch regional-splay-v2 rollout (lee)
- implement cache purge on reroute (anya)
- add alert that correlates rollout times with shard concentration (sre)
- follow-up customer comms (cust-success)

router-eng-lee: filing a PR to gate weight-decay evaluation and add unit test for sticky-evap TTL. I'll also prepare a safe rollback.

sre-oncall-morgan: handing off to router-eng for root cause and post-mortem. oncall handoff: @router-eng-lee you own next 3 hours. I'll remain on standby.

prod-ops: creating incident bridge for postmortem at 1759124100.

cust-success-jorge: I'll send update to customers when we confirm full validation.

incident-bot: incident updated: severity->P1 mitigated->partial, assignees: router-eng-lee, ingress-eng-anya, sre-oncall-morgan. Links: runbook: https://wiki.redwood.local/incidents/ingress-splay-2026
